acceptance: At least eight independently developed applications are pinned, licensed and partitioned by shared template family; expected structure is annotated by a separate process that never saw recognizer output; the held-out partition is committed sealed; a reproducible harness measures structural recognition, semantic accuracy, false claims, missing composite capabilities and workflow coverage with explicit denominators on the unmodified recognizer, so B11-T01 can rank failure clusters.

positive.fixture: 10 sources / 7 families / 55 page states captured with the production observer; 55 annotations; baseline on 32 development and validation pages and 23 held-out pages (aggregate only); 55/55 structure digests reproduce

negative.fixture: unpinned, unlicensed, contaminated and unannotated manifests refused; unpinned or traversing CDN addresses not mirrored; static server cannot leave its root; annotation claiming to have seen recognizer output or naming an unknown item rejected; contradicting recognition counted as a false claim
negative.command: node --conditions=source --test --test-name-pattern=refused|only pinned|stays inside|must declare|false claim tests/corpus/test/corpus.test.ts

versions.schema: new: vsf-corpus-v1, vsf-corpus-annotation-v1, vsf-corpus-result-v1; no IR change

security_and_source_permissions: Only public, permissively licensed applications run locally; no private service, credential or CAPTCHA involved; the File Browser test account exists only in a disposable database; external requests are blocked except registry-verified pinned npm files.
performance_memory_storage: Capture 0.6 to 3.5 s per page; recognizer p50 26.7 ms, max 36.5 ms, peak RSS 11.1 MB at up to 2716 nodes; cache under .corpus-cache is git-ignored.
known_limitations: Ten applications from seven families are a small public sample
Annotators are model sessions, not humans; inter-annotator agreement was not measured
Executable-operation correctness is not measured yet (T05, T06)
The held-out seal is procedural; annotations are readable in the repository
AdminLTE calendar dropped; Choices remote-data selects are empty because external APIs are blocked
